instructions.grasp-can: Use the {arm} arm to grasp {can} from the table without moving {pot}.
instructions.lift-can: Use the {arm} arm to lift {can} clear of the table and move it away from nearby obstacles.
instructions.place-can-beside-pot: Use the {arm} arm to place {can} upright beside {pot} on the same side as its initial position, then open the gripper and withdraw.
instructions.grasp-pot: Use the {arm} arm to grasp {pot} while keeping the other arm and its held object still.
instructions.align-pot: Use the {arm} arm to return {pot} to its configured reference placement, then release it and withdraw.

predicates.empty: The named arm is not holding any object and its gripper is available for the next grasp.
predicates.can-arm: The configured arm assigned to manipulate this can, determined by the side of the can in the initial layout.
predicates.pot-arm: The configured arm assigned to restore this pot while the other arm can retain its grasp.
predicates.target-pot: The configured pot beside which the can must be placed.
predicates.can-on-table: The can is supported by the table and is not being held by either gripper.
predicates.pot-on-table: The pot is supported by the table and is not being held by a gripper.
predicates.holding-can: The named arm securely holds the named can, supported by visual grasp evidence and gripper feedback.
predicates.holding-pot: The named arm securely holds the named pot, supported by visual grasp evidence and gripper feedback.
predicates.lifted: The can has been raised clear of the tabletop while remaining securely held.
predicates.pot-aligned: The pot matches the configured reference placement and the can-placement region remains clear. Use null if the reference placement cannot be established from the supplied calibration and observation.
predicates.beside: The released can is upright on the table beside the pot on its configured side, with positive lateral separation below 0.2 m and longitudinal offset below 0.035 m. Use null if image calibration or occlusion prevents a reliable spatial judgment.

objects.left: The robot's left arm and gripper.
objects.right: The robot's right arm and gripper.
objects.sauce-can: The sauce can actor named can in RoboTwin move_can_pot; this initial symbolic problem assigns it to the left arm.
objects.kitchen-pot: The kitchen pot actor named pot in RoboTwin move_can_pot. Its calibrated reference placement must be supplied for the episode.
